name: Choukyou na no Desu! ~Sou Sou. Mo~tto, Watashi o Ijimete Ii no yo?~
original_name: 調教なのです! ～そうそう。も～っと、私を虐めていいのよ?～
source:
The commander applies what may be called occult training to Inazuma and Ikazuchi.
Anal pleasures break the spirit of two KanC*lle fleet members.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ137335.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
指挥官对闪电和五十土进行了所谓的神秘训练。
肛交的快感让两名KanC*lle舰队成员精神崩溃。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ137335.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
